alignments.note: אַף כִּי is a fixed particle pair rendered by the single expression *How much less*; neither morpheme owns a part of it. Source head on the governing first particle (rule 23); target head on the content word *less* (rule 24).
The Hebrew writes a verbless predication (man [is] a maggot); the ASV subordinates it to the noun with a supplied relative that no morpheme licenses (rules 46, 55).
Nominal predicate takes the construction-supplied copula (rule 20) and its own indefinite article (rule 15).
Second supplied relative over a juxtaposed verbless predication, on the same terms as the first (rules 46, 55).
Nominal predicate takes the copula and its indefinite article (rules 20, 15).

review_notes: Both *that*s are supplied subordinators over verbless predications the Hebrew juxtaposes to their subjects; the copulas and articles stay with the predicate nouns.
